content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, for which prior authorization was missing. The patient has recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness, prompting evaluation for an underlying arrhythmic etiology. Given the history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management."}
